rows.text: • The Company reaffirmed its full year 2026 guidance of expected premium revenue of approximately $42 billion and adjusted earnings of at least $5.25 per diluted share.
The Company expects its full year 2026 GAAP earnings to be at least $2.38 per diluted share and reaffirmed its full year 2026 adjusted earnings of at least $5.25 per diluted share.
